incident-bot: Page fired -> PD: P1 - cuda_alloc_failures high on us-west2-gpu-pool-42 (auto-threshold)
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident: INC-2026-8743 triggered (route: gpu-memory-pressure)
Samir K.: acked on PD :white_check_mark: I'm taking initial triage — pinging infra.
Anya L.: :eyes: seeing steady increase in OOMs and mmap failure traces in the last 2m. KVCache eviction rate jumped 8x.
Jordan P.: Any customer-facing degradations? Logs showing fallback models? We should assess impact.
Priya R.: Not seeing user 5xxs in API gateway yet, but internal job retries are spiking. Could be graceful fallback masking errors upstream.
Samir K.: quick checks I'm running: ssh to node, grabbing /var/log/syslog and nvidia-smi, pulling k8s pod logs.
Samir K.: run:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/redwood-gpu-pool-42 -c runtime --since=3m | grep -E "CUDA|OOM|mmap|alloc"
ssh gpu-usw2-78 sudo journalctl -u redwood-runtime --since "2 minutes ago" | tail -n 200
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv
```
Anya L.: paste of relevant lines from logs:
```
E 03:14:02 runtime.cpp:987] CUDA error: out of memory when allocating 67108864 bytes
W 03:14:02 kvcache.cpp:254] KVCache eviction spike: evict_count=12452 window=60s
E 03:14:03 mmap failed: Cannot allocate memory (12)
```
Samir K.: I can repro an alloc fail on node gpu-usw2-78. GPU memory graph shows repeated spikes then slow decay -> looks like hot prefix reuse but KVCACHE thrashing.
Jordan P.: Ops SRE, can we throttle new attach requests or mark pool drained so orchestrator stops scheduling new sessions to that pool?
Ops SRE: Initiating drain on pool us-west2-gpu-pool-42 now. Running drain command, will wait for in-flight tokens to finish then move traffic.
Priya R.: We should also enable fallback routing to cpu-model-legacy for lower-sla tiers to reduce pressure on the GPUs. Can set routing rule via console now.
Anya L.: Checking auto-shedder: threshold for this pool was 0.6 mem-pressure, but observed mem-pressure 0.83 for multiple hosts. Auto-shedder didn't trigger because eviction_throttle was overridden in last rollout.
Samir K.: @Anya can you confirm which rollout changed eviction_throttle? If it's the recent kvcache tuning, roll back if safe.
Anya L.: It was config commit 9f3b2e earlier today by infra-team, changed eviction_throttle to 0.9 to reduce false positives. Reverting to 0.6 now.
Jordan P.: Rolling revert via infra-runbook now. Patch apply in progress: rollback config 9f3b2e -> 4a7c1b.
Ops SRE: Drain complete for pool us-west2-gpu-pool-42. New sessions redirected. Current running sessions 12 -> 4 remaining (will complete or be allowed to fallback).
Samir K.: Noting impact: no customer-facing 5xxs observed yet; internal long-tail latencies for demo customers ~ p95->2.8s. We'll keep track — putting customer-impact note in incident doc.
pagerduty: Auto-escalation to L2 after 5m due to sustained p1 condition.
Anya L.: After revert, eviction rate trending down, OOMs reduced from 14/min to 2/min in last 90s. Monitoring.
Priya R.: I'll push a temporary routing rule to demote non-paid tiers to fallback CPU model to reduce churn.
Samir K.: Command used to change routing (safe preview):
```
redwoodctl routes update --pool us-west2-gpu-pool-42 --fallback-model cpu-small --target-classes free,trial
```
Samir K.: Doing handoff to Jordan in 10m for follow-up and postmortem capture. Leaving notes in incident doc: probable root cause = kvcache tuning change reduced eviction sensitivity, causing hot prefixes to thrash mmap/KV allocations and produce CUDA OOMs under high reuse.
Jordan P.: Taking over oncall in 12m. I'll verify rollback success, ensure auto-shedder thresholds are fixed, and run a short soak test on a stress harness.
Ops SRE: Scheduled a rolling restart of runtime pods in the pool to clear any fragmenting allocations; doing 2-at-a-time.
Anya L.: After restart and config revert, current OOMs=0/min, KVCache evicts back to baseline. Still watching for recurrence.
Priya R.: I'll coordinate with customer-success for any customers who reported latency blips; putting a note in the incident doc.
Samir K.: Thanks all. Quick timeline summary for the doc:
- 03:12: PD fired due to CUDA alloc failures and high kvcache evictions
- 03:13: Samir ack, triage started, SSH/logs collected
- 03:14: Drain initiated on pool us-west2-gpu-pool-42
- 03:16: Revert kvcache throttle config (9f3b2e -> 4a7c1b)
- 03:18: Routing changes to fallback CPU models for lower tiers
- 03:20: Restart runtime pods 2-at-a-time
- 03:22: OOMs reduced to baseline, monitoring

Jordan P.: I'll take over and post the incident page + initial RCA draft within 2 hours. If anything flares up I'll re-notify PD.
incident-bot: Incident state update -> acknowledged by Samir K., automatic escalation queued; tags: gpu, cuda, kvcache, oom, routing
Samir K.: handing off: Jordan, I've attached collected logs and commands to the incident ticket. Good handoff. :handshake:
Jordan P.: got it, taking point. :thumbsup:
